progression_rate.rationale: Standard 10% rule for safe weekly mileage progression

training_frequency.rationale: Current frequency is 2.9 runs/week - increasing to 3 for marathon training

training_principles: Follow the 10% rule for weekly mileage increases
Include one long run per week (20-30% of weekly mileage)
Allow adequate recovery between hard sessions
Listen to your body and adjust as needed
safety_guidelines: Stop training if you experience pain
Increase mileage gradually (10% per week maximum)
Consult a healthcare provider for any concerns
